claims.text: Setting the PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN environment variable on the self-hosted Pulumi Cloud API service lets Terraform and OpenTofu use the self-hosted Pulumi Cloud as a state backend.
PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN is the environment variable on the self-hosted Pulumi Cloud API service that specifies the domain serving the Terraform-compatible API.
When PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN is unset in self-hosted Pulumi Cloud, the Terraform-compatible API is disabled and its routes aren't registered.
The DNS record for the PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN domain should point at the same host that serves PULUMI_API_DOMAIN in self-hosted Pulumi Cloud.
In self-hosted Pulumi Cloud, PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN can be set to the same value as PULUMI_API_DOMAIN; a separate domain is not required.
The Pulumi state backend guide (/docs/integrations/terraform/state-backend/) uses tf.pulumi.com as the domain in the Terraform/OpenTofu configuration, login command, and TF_TOKEN_* variable name.
For self-hosted Pulumi Cloud, the Terraform/OpenTofu configuration, the terraform login or tofu login command, and the TF_TOKEN_* variable name should use the PULUMI_TFE_DOMAIN value.
